UPDATE feed
           SET url = ?,
               status = CASE WHEN status IN ('paused', 'too_many_errors', 'gone', 'duplicate')
                             THEN status ELSE ? END,
               failure_count = ?,
               last_error = ?,
               last_refresh = ?,
               next_poll_at = ?,
               etag = ?,
               last_modified = ?,
               ttl_secs = ?,
               skip_hours = ?,
               skip_days = ?,
               moved_from = ?,
               redirected_to = ?
           WHERE pk = ?
